references.text: Describes the promised land as flowing with milk and honey, the same expression used in Deuteronomy 31:20
The land flowing with milk and honey, the promise given to the fathers
The promise of the land flowing with milk and honey, given to the fathers
Warning that when the people become full and prosperous, they may forget the Lord
Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; he abandoned God who made him - fulfillment of the warning
Warning against turning to other gods and worshipping them
The prophecy that the people will turn to foreign gods and break the covenant
Warning that Israel will abandon the Lord and serve foreign gods
Fulfillment of the prophecy: Israel abandoned the Lord and followed other gods
The people have despised the Holy One of Israel, corresponding to 'they despised me' in Deuteronomy
The fathers broke the covenant with the Lord, fulfilling the warning in Deuteronomy
Hosea describes how Israel became full and forgot God
Nehemiah recounts the story of how the fathers became full and rebellious against God
